(import scheme (chicken base) (chicken io))

(define (main)
  (let* ((first (read-line))
         (ns-ms (string-split first #\space))
         (n (string->number (car ns-ms)))
         (m (string->number (cadr ns-ms)))
         (graph (make-vector n '()))
         (last (read-line))
         (ss-ts (string-split last #\space))
         (s (string->number (car ss-ts)))
         (t (string->number (cadr ss-ts))))
    (do ((i 0 (+ i 1)))
        ((= i m))
      (let* ((line (read-line))
             (us-vs (string-split line #\space))
             (u (string->number (car us-vs)))
             (v (string->number (cadr us-vs))))
        (vector-set! graph u (cons v (vector-ref graph u)))))
    (let ((result (bfs (list (cons s 0)) (list s) graph t)))
      (display result)
      (newline))))

(define (bfs queue seen graph target)
  (if (null? queue)
      -1
      (let ((node-distance (car queue)))
        (if (= (cdr node-distance) target)
            (cdr node-distance)
            (let* ((node (car node-distance))
                   (distance (cdr node-distance))
                   (neighbors (vector-ref graph node))
                   (new-seen (remove-member node seen))
                   (added (filter (lambda (x) (not (member x new-seen))) neighbors))
                   (entries (map (lambda (x) (cons x (+ distance 1))) added))
                   (new-queue (append queue entries)))
              (bfs new-queue new-seen graph target))))))

(define (remove-member item lst)
  (cond ((null? lst) '())
        ((eq? item (car lst)) (cdr lst))
        (else (cons (car lst) (remove-member item (cdr lst))))))

(main)
